title: There's No Place Like Home...
start: Talk to Alfred Stonemason in Rimmington.

items.t: Two regular logs (obtainable once during quest)

rewards.l: Construction XP Lamp (There's No Place Like Home...)
Construction supplies (There's No Place Like Home...)

rewards.t: There's no place like home painting
rewards.l: There's no place like home painting

rewards.t: Ability to cast House Teleport spell

steps.t: Talk to Alfred Stonemason in Rimmington to learn about player-owned houses.
Talk to the estate agent to receive a plot of land.
Enter the house portal.
Talk to Alfred Stonemason.
Walk to the arrow.
Talk to Alfred Stonemason.
Use the Remove Furniture option in the House Controls interface to clean up leftover items.
Exit house portal.
Cut planks using the sawmill.
Talk to Alfred Stonemason, who will direct you to the furniture workbench.
Use the furniture workbench to create a crude wooden chair.
Store the crude wooden chair in the furniture storage.
Enter the house portal.
Talk to Alfred Stonemason.
Enter build mode and place the crude wooden chair.
Click the chair again to change its position.
Talk to Alfred and enter build mode again.
Edit a doorway to add a room.
Edit another doorway to customise it.
Exit house portal.
Talk to Alfred Stonemason.
Quest complete!
